overview_text: The Bachelor of Science in Chemical Engineering and Artificial Intelligence provides students with the technical and analytical skills to work with large data sets. The curriculum focuses on the application of artificial intelligence methods to solve problems in the chemical engineering field, including the development of predictive models, optimization of processes, and the design of experiments. Students also have an opportunity to learn data visualization, machine learning, and a variety of artificial intelligence techniques.
